title: rosa micrantha var. nemorosa
intro: Rosa micrantha var. nemorosa, commonly known as the Wood's Rose or Alpine Rose, is a flowering plant species in the rose family that is native to the mountainous regions of Europe. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties that can help to soothe and calm the body. The therapeutic actions of Rosa micrantha var. nemorosa include reducing anxiety and stress, promoting relaxation, and supporting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
